smyx-adult-facial-fatigue-stress-index-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release for comprehensive adult facial fatigue/stress index analysis using high-resolution images or short videos.
- Detects key facial features: under-eye bag area, dark-circle grayscale, mouth-corner drop angle, and glabellar frown lines.
- Outputs a quantifiable fatigue/stress index (0-100) with level classification and targeted rest/relaxation suggestions.
- Includes strict open-id fetching and validation workflow for report history and data access.
- Designed for integration with smart mirrors, office health systems, and personal health management apps.
- Privacy and usage guidelines provided to ensure compliant and user-friendly operation.
